svg.text: Floor 170 x 105 x 2 mm with two dividers 2 mm thick and 60 tall,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 17 mm each side of the centre, running the full length.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holds 24 pens of 16 mm, three pairs across and four layers up.

svg.text: Fit: drops into the liner with 1 mm all round.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cooling end, held by its clip on the liner end wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a 16 mm rod slides freely between each divider and the wall.
